label: Fast filters from closed forms
subgoals: Evaluate depth and node count for each candidate architecture
Discard candidates whose depth misses the timing budget
Rank the survivors by node count

label: Recursing to the accurate engines
subgoals: Send only candidates near the budget or near each other to synthesis
Record the fast estimate beside the accurate result
Calibrate the fast model from the gap

label: Objectives and traps
subgoals: Choose an objective that encodes the hard constraints
Keep the Pareto set of delay, area and power
Check what synthesis actually built before crediting an architecture
